# 'secret' Dialect

Secret is a dialect for computations that operate on encrypted data.
Secret is intended to serve as a scheme-agnostic front-end for the Aegis
ecosystem of dialects.

### `secret.conceal` (aegis::secret::ConcealOp)

_Convert a non-secret value into a secret_


Syntax:

```
operation ::= `secret.conceal` $cleartext attr-dict `:` type($cleartext) `->` type($output)
```

Convert a value to a secret containing the same value.

Examples:

```mlir
%Y = secret.conceal %value : i32 -> !secret.secret<i32>
```

### `secret.div` (aegis::secret::DivOp)

_Divide two secret values_

The "div" operation performs element-wise divide between two secret tensors.
The shapes of the tensor operands are expected to match.

Example:
```mlir
"secret.div"(%a, %b): (!Secete.Secret<i32>, !Secete.Secret<i32>) -> (!ecete.Secret<i32>)
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`, `Commutative`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`
